Hymn 271: Oh, Holy Words of Truth and Love
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Evan Stephens
Lyricist/Text Author: Joseph L. Townsend
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 271 titled "Oh, Holy Words of Truth and Love" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Evan Stephens and the lyrics were written by Joseph L. Townsend.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
